#### `stc.cogitator.workstation.desktop`

Desktop environment for the workstation. A workstation always has a DE —
a machine without one is a server, not a workstation. Currently only
"plasma" (KDE Plasma 6). Extensible: adding "i3" means a new cogitator-i3
and an extra value here.

- **Type:** `value "plasma" (singular enum)`
- **Default:** `"plasma"`
- **Declared in:** [`cogitator/nixos/workstation.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/cogitator/nixos/workstation.nix)

#### `stc.cogitator.workstation.enable`

Whether to enable hardened workstation profile (desktop + hardening + YubiKey).

- **Type:** `boolean`
- **Default:** `false`
- **Example:** `true`
- **Declared in:** [`cogitator/nixos/workstation.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/cogitator/nixos/workstation.nix)

#### `stc.cogitator.workstation.hardening.filesystem.enable`

Enable filesystem hardening (/tmp noexec, /proc hidepid=2, /dev/shm
restricted). Set false if hidepid=2 disturbs polkit / user D-Bus agents
on your desktop and you have not wired them into the "proc" group.

- **Type:** `boolean`
- **Default:** `true`
- **Declared in:** [`cogitator/nixos/workstation.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/cogitator/nixos/workstation.nix)

#### `stc.cogitator.workstation.hardening.filesystem.gaming`

Relax filesystem hardening for Steam/Proton: drop noexec on /tmp and
/dev/shm (kept nosuid/nodev, hidepid stays). Set true on a gaming
workstation. Pair with cogitator-gaming for the GPU + Steam side.

- **Type:** `boolean`
- **Default:** `false`
- **Declared in:** [`cogitator/nixos/workstation.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/cogitator/nixos/workstation.nix)

#### `stc.cogitator.workstation.yubikey`

Enable YubiKey system support (pcscd + udev rules). Set false on a workstation with no key.

- **Type:** `boolean`
- **Default:** `true`
- **Declared in:** [`cogitator/nixos/workstation.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/cogitator/nixos/workstation.nix)
